title: RiX Numerics direct range-provider result
description: Portable structural contract for rix.numerics.range-provider-result@1. Passing this schema is necessary but not sufficient for certification; Numerics must also validate identity, work bounds, evidence, and provider authority.

status.description: Whether a range claim was produced and whether its requested refinement goal was met. Domain coverage is reported separately.

domainStatus.description: Certified coverage of the requested input by the real domain, independent of range status.

achievedEndpointTolerance.description: An exact nonnegative rational in the RiX runtime; its tagged JSON form is accepted here as an object.
